items.name: kumo
items.title: Kumo setup
items.description: Installs @cloudflare/kumo and its peer dependencies and adds Kumo's Tailwind v4 styles to your CSS. Every component item includes this setup too.
items.docs: Kumo needs Tailwind CSS v4. Your Tailwind CSS file now has @import "@cloudflare/kumo/styles/tailwind" and @source "../node_modules/@cloudflare/kumo/dist/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}". That @source path assumes the CSS file is one folder below node_modules (app/globals.css, src/index.css); fix it if yours is deeper. See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#styles

items.docs: Kumo needs Tailwind CSS v4. Your Tailwind CSS file now has @import "@cloudflare/kumo/styles/tailwind" and @source "../node_modules/@cloudflare/kumo/dist/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}". That @source path assumes the CSS file is one folder below node_modules (app/globals.css, src/index.css); fix it if yours is deeper. See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#styles
